root_cause: base_model key in configs/mlx_lora_explanations.yaml was never passed to mlx_lm's 'model' parameter. The training script mapped config keys to lora_args only when the key names matched. 'base_model' != 'model', so model defaulted to mlx_lm.lora.CONFIG_DEFAULTS['model'] = 'Qwen/Qwen3-0.6b'. The adapter was trained against Qwen3-0.6b (hidden_dim=1024) but evaluated against Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit (hidden_dim=1536), causing a matmul shape mismatch on every generation call.
error_observed: [matmul] Last dimension of first input with shape (1,N,1536) must match second to last dimension of second input with shape (1024,8).
fix_applied: Added one line to scripts/train_mlx_lora_explanations.py before the CONFIG_DEFAULTS loop: lora_args['model'] = config['base_model']
retrain_note: Adapter was retrained with correct base model (mlx-community/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit), first 80 iters then extended to 300 iters.
format_compliance_note: Format compliance improved from 0.0 (80 iters) to 0.2 (300 iters, 10-example eval). Partial structured output compliance achieved. Some outputs show prompt leakage after <|endoftext|> token.

verdict_prediction_adapter.note: This adapter was trained on verifier-format data (verdict prediction), not explanation SFT data. It has proper measured metrics.

explanation_adapter_status.note: Generation works after fix. Format compliance is partial (0.2) at 300 iters. Some outputs echo the system prompt after <|endoftext|> — max_tokens or stop-token tuning would suppress this. Not production-grade but demonstrates the fix is effective.
